title: Air-fryer kebab skewers
subtitle: Mixed meat and vegetable skewers cooked in the air fryer.
excerpt: Chunks of beef or lamb threaded onto skewers with peppers and onion, marinated briefly, then air-fried until the meat is charred at the edges and the vegetables are soft. Ready in 15 minutes. Serves four.
sourceNotes: Kebab skewers (shish kebab) are a grilled preparation common across Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cooking. This air-fryer version threads cubed meat with vegetables for a quick weeknight version without a barbecue.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Assemble skewers and refrigerate for up to 8 hours before cooking.

content.text: Kebab skewers need two things to cook evenly: pieces of a similar size so they cook at the same rate, and a short rest in the marinade so the surface flavour develops before cooking. Cut meat and vegetables into roughly 3 cm pieces. Soak wooden skewers for 30 minutes before using, or use flat metal ones.

items.prepNote: or lamb shoulder, cut into 3 cm cubes
deseeded and cut into 3 cm pieces
cut into 3 cm chunks, layers separated

content.text: Combine {{beef-sirloin}} of beef cubes with {{olive-oil}} of olive oil, {{cumin-ground}} of cumin, {{paprika-smoked}} of smoked paprika, {{garlic-powder}} of garlic powder, and {{sea-salt-fine}} of salt. Toss well and leave for 30 minutes. Thread alternating pieces of meat, {{pepper-red}} red pepper, and {{red-onion}} red onion onto skewers.
Preheat the air fryer to 200°C. Cook skewers for 6 minutes, turn, and cook for 5-6 more minutes until the meat is charred at the edges and the vegetables are soft and slightly coloured.

items.cause: Marinade too wet, or fryer not preheated.
items.fix: Shake excess oil from the skewers before cooking. Make sure the fryer is hot.

items.symptom: Vegetables burning before meat is done
items.cause: Vegetables cut smaller than the meat.
items.fix: Keep all pieces the same size, about 3 cm. Smaller veg chars faster than large meat chunks.
Soak wooden skewers in cold water for at least 30 minutes. Alternatively, use flat metal skewers which conduct heat to the centre of the meat.

content.text: Kebab skewers in the air fryer are good for a quick weeknight dinner or as part of a mezze spread. Serve with flatbreads, hummus, and a herb salad. The same method works with chicken breast or thighs for a lighter version.
